steps.what: Count hospital and laboratory supplies on the shelves.
Name item, quantity, unit and supplier for each shortage.
File supply order v1 for the supplies she named.
Check supply order v1 quotes only the lines she named.
Send restock orders in supply order v1 to the supplier.

tasks.design: She counts the shelves and names item, quantity, unit and supplier. A separate step files supply order v1 in {PROCUREMENT}, she checks that version, and a further step sends only that version to the supplier. The send is not folded into the count, no stock alert is raised, and the order does not time her.
tasks.previous_blocker: The shortage was counted on the shelf and then ordered by phone, so there was no standing order to check before it left.
tasks.enabler_now: A purchasing screen can file item, quantity, unit and supplier from the lines she has already named, and send that version after she checks it.
tasks.still_hard: A supplier who will not take an electronic order, or a line with no item number, still needs her note or a phone call.
tasks.human_edge: Seeing which bottle is actually short, and refusing a line she did not name.
tasks.altitude: She still counts every shelf and names every line, then checks supply order v1 before it is sent. She stops retyping an order she has already specified. She does not gain a right to let a par level choose the order, or to send an order she has not checked.

reach.task: Confirm item, quantity and lead time on a supply order
reach.learn: Which suppliers will accept an electronic order without a phone call.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge, not a measured study of this firm: counting shelves and naming what is short is the bulk of this task. Filing and sending an order she has already specified is the small slice, and only when the supplier accepts that send.
Works-council consent is required before logs are used to watch staff. This restock order records item, quantity, unit and supplier. It does not log her speed or her hours.
Using logs to evaluate staff performance is the high-risk case named for this digest. This restock order does not score her or assign her next task.

assumptions: The practice manager maintains item number, pack size and supplier on the item master in the purchasing system, outside this task, and that upkeep is not counted as saved. She still counts the shelf.

In the name step she records item, quantity, unit and supplier. That capture stays at full time. If any of those is missing, the file step and the send step do not run and she orders by phone or on paper as she does today.
Supply order v1 is filed first. She then checks that version against the lines she named. The send transmits only that checked version. A change after the check voids both the file and the send.
The only send outside the organisation is supply order v1 to the supplier. Counting and naming are not sends. No stock alert is raised. The order does not store her hours or a speed score.
Upkeep of 0.4 hours per 100 hours of this task is a line the supplier rejects, which she then rewrites by phone.
unknowns: Whether a purchasing clerk, rather than the veterinary assistant, places supplier orders today.
Whether item number, pack size and supplier are already on the item master.
Whether this supplier accepts an electronic order.
research_questions: Which of item, quantity, unit and supplier does she already name before anyone calls the supplier?

incremental.description: When the supplier rejects a line, rewrite that order by phone.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low is a week of phone orders and missing item numbers, so she never files an order and the send does not run. High is 4, only filing and sending supply order v1 after she has named item, quantity, unit and supplier and has checked that version. Counting and naming stay.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List price and pack size from the clinic till.
Sell pet food or supplies to customers and take payment.

tasks.design: A separate step lists price and pack size from the clinic till ({OTHER}) when the product record already holds them. She still sells the food to the customer and takes the payment herself. No receipt is emailed, and no stock alert is raised.
tasks.previous_blocker: The price sat on a shelf label or in her memory, and the sale was the conversation at the counter.
tasks.enabler_now: The till can show price and pack size for a product it already holds, so she does not hunt a second label.
tasks.still_hard: Matching a food to this animal, and the sale itself, stay with her at the counter.
tasks.human_edge: Choosing a food this animal will eat, and hearing what the customer came for.
tasks.altitude: She still makes every sale and takes the payment. She stops guessing a price the till already holds. She does not gain a right to let the till choose the food.

reach.task: Choose the food or supply for this animal
reach.learn: Which pack and price the till already shows before she names a substitute.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge, not a measured study of this firm: selling food at the counter and taking payment is the work. A price lookup is a small slice, and only when the till already holds that product.
Works-council consent is required before logs are used to watch staff. This price list does not log her speed or her hours.
Using logs to evaluate staff performance is the high-risk case named for this digest. This price list does not score her or assign her next task.

assumptions: The practice manager maintains price and pack size on the clinic till product record, outside this task, and that upkeep is not counted as saved. A blank price leaves the list empty and she reads the shelf label. The sale stays at full time.

Selling and taking payment are the live conversation with the customer, who is outside the organisation. She still rings the till herself. No receipt is emailed and no sale record is filed by a machine, so there is no separate commit to gate.
The price list does not store her hours or a speed score, and it does not raise an alert.
Upkeep of 0.2 hours per 100 hours of this task is a price the till shows that she rechecks against the shelf label.
unknowns: Whether shelf prices and till prices are the same record.
Whether she rings sales on a till today or only on a cash drawer.
research_questions: Does the clinic till already hold a price and a pack size for the foods she sells?

incremental.description: When the till price looks wrong, recheck it against the shelf label.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low is a product the till does not hold, so the list is empty and she reads the shelf label during the sale, which stays hers. High is 1, only the price and pack lookup, when the till already has them. The sale and the payment stay.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List drug, dose and route from the clinical record.
Administer anesthetics during surgery and monitor effects on animals.

tasks.design: A separate step lists drug, dose and route from the clinical record ({OTHER}) when the veterinarian has already entered them. She still draws up, gives the anesthetic and watches the animal. The list does not set the dose, no vitals alert is raised, and no record is filed by a machine.
tasks.previous_blocker: The dose was on the veterinarian's plan or said aloud, and she gave the drug while watching the animal.
tasks.enabler_now: The clinical record can show drug, dose and route when the veterinarian has already entered those fields.
tasks.still_hard: Drawing up the dose, giving it, and judging the animal's breathing and depth stay with her.
tasks.human_edge: Seeing that this animal is too deep or too light, and stopping.
tasks.altitude: She still gives every anesthetic and watches every animal. She stops hunting a dose the veterinarian already wrote. She does not gain a right to let the list set the dose.

reach.task: Write the anesthetic order before surgery
reach.learn: Which drug, dose and route this case may follow, and when the record is blank.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge, not a measured study of this firm: drawing up, giving and watching the anesthetic is the work. A list of the ordered dose is a small slice, and it is not permission to anesthetize.
Works-council consent is required before logs are used to watch staff. This dose list does not log her speed or her hours.
Using logs to evaluate staff performance is the high-risk case named for this digest. This dose list does not score her or assign her next task.

assumptions: The veterinarian records drug, dose and route on the clinical record before surgery, outside this task, and that capture is not counted as saved. A blank field leaves the list empty. She asks the veterinarian, and giving the drug stays at full time.
The list does not set the dose and does not authorise her to anesthetize. She still draws up, gives and watches the animal under supervision.
This task does not file an anesthetic record, send a message, or raise a vitals alert. Remarks to the surgeon are talk with a colleague, not a send outside the organisation.
The list does not store her hours or a speed score.
Upkeep of 0.2 hours per 100 hours of this task is a blank or stale dose she confirms with the veterinarian before she draws up.
unknowns: Whether the anesthetic plan is a structured clinical record or only a spoken order.
Whether drug, dose and route are separate fields the veterinarian fills before she draws up.
research_questions: Does the veterinarian record drug, dose and route before she draws up, and in which fields?

incremental.description: When the recorded dose is blank or stale, confirm it with the veterinarian before drawing up.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low is a spoken order with no structured dose, so the list is empty and she asks before she draws up. High is 1, only the dose lookup, when the veterinarian already entered drug, dose and route. Giving the drug and watching the animal stay.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: She still counts the shelves, sells the food and takes the payment, and gives and watches every anesthetic. The order draft does not choose the lines, the till does not make the sale, and the dose list does not set the anesthetic. She does not gain a right to send an order she has not checked.
reach: supplier (which suppliers accept an electronic supply order)
customer (which pack and price the till already shows)
veterinarian (which drug, dose and route are already on the record)
skills_to_grow: Refuse a send of supply order v1 until she has checked that version.
Read a blank till price as a blank, and use the shelf label.
Stop before drawing up when drug, dose or route is missing.
role.ambitious_version: She raises a restock order the same day a shelf is short, and she refuses a line she did not name. The sale and the anesthetic stay hers. No unchecked order goes to a supplier.
